name: findcheap
description: Finds where a product is sold for less: give it a product page's address and get the same product and its equivalents, cheapest first, with links to the retailers.

interface.longDescription:
Findcheap is an AI search tool that finds where products are available for a lower price. With the Findcheap plugin, you can compare prices across thousands of retailers, and find out whether a listing is a good price before you buy. If the page already has the best available price, Findcheap will say so. When ChatGPT is shopping for you, it can check a product with Findcheap before recommending it.

Give Findcheap a link for a product page, and it will search the internet to find where the product is sold for less. You can also ask what the page sells and get information like its title, brand and price without a search. Findcheap supports individuals, businesses, and personal AI assistants looking to save money while shopping online.
defaultPrompt: Find where this is available for a lower price: https://findcheap.ai/sample-product
What's being sold on this page? https://findcheap.ai/sample-product-2
Is this a good price? Check this listing before I buy: https://findcheap.ai/sample-product-3

positive.description: Find the same product for less
positive.prompt: Use Findcheap to find this cheaper: https://findcheap.ai/sample-product-3
positive.expected_behavior: Return the same product at other retailers and similar products, each with a price, a retailer and a link.

positive.description: Check whether a listing is a good price
positive.prompt: Is this a good price? https://findcheap.ai/sample-product-2
positive.expected_behavior: Compare the page's price with the same product at other retailers and say whether it is the lowest found.

positive.description: Read a product page without running a search
positive.prompt: What does this page sell? https://findcheap.ai/sample-product-3
positive.expected_behavior: Return the page's title, brand and price without running a search.

positive.description: Find equivalents for a fashion item
positive.prompt: Find these shoes or something like them for less: https://findcheap.ai/sample-product
positive.expected_behavior: Return the same shoes if sold elsewhere and similar shoes, each with a price, a retailer and a link.
Return pre-owned listings of the same product, each with a price, a retailer and a link.

Account changes are not made through the plugin
negative.prompt: Cancel my Findcheap account and delete my data.

negative.description: Unsupported task: Findcheap finds prices, it does not track orders
negative.prompt: Track my Amazon order and tell me when it arrives.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and processes no payments. Every result leads to the retailer's own page, where any purchase happens. Some of those links may be affiliate links, as our Terms of Service say.

publication.release_notes: First release: find where a product is sold for less, read a product page, and see the results in a panel. Sign in with Findcheap.
